full_page.content:
1935, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 335 Cont.
Apr. 17 Mrs. Marguerite Mc Conkey - 34 - convert from unitarinism & Baptism - has been deserted by husband, simply because she gently insisted on going to Holy Communion. Her first fearful cross was the sight of her dear parents becoming divorced. This also was first incen- tive to examine into the one Church so absolutely against such a moral & social pest. Apr. 14 Reported "Back home & more reasonable."
18 Walter Daly - 15 - leg twice badly bruised - then become infected and terribly swolen. Dr's decided it should by all means come off. Father refused to permit it. Amputation, they said, should be at once - last Monday, but at latest following Thursday (To-day) - is feeling better now, was enrolled - Father promises perpetual ... if ... Blank Page
Page 336 Page 337
Apr. 20 Justin Murray - 32 - of Alma, Mich. toncil-operation feared .... T. Manion Br .- in-1. "one in a million recovered 3 yrs. ago.
21 Perry Lewis - 27 - Episcopelian - raised quite prejudicial from reading as a child he concluded" ... one thing ... I'll never be a Cath- olic" now hopes to be a priest though not as yet decided on when to start the step ...
21 Wm. Schumaker - 27 - baptized a lutheran - very nervous hand near 2 yrs. Enrolled To-night x
Marion Sundblade - Methodist - skin trouble 4-5 yrs.
22 Mrs. L. Laurell - 41 - has six child'n-almost blind and curviture of spine.
Vina Bond - 36 - husband & 2 .... Extremly nervous - in Receiving Hosp .. . . .
23 Stephen Kocher - N.C. - 47 - out of work - rhumatism .... Enrolled x Philomene Dufresne - 55 - nervous - tumor removed from breast - in doing so was badly burned.
John Hofmeyer - 6 - threatened mastoid.
Page 338 Blank Page.
